name: NTU RGB+D: 3D Action Recognition Dataset
description: A comprehensive benchmark for 3D human activity analysis captured by the ROSE Lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore). Recorded concurrently from 3 Microsoft Kinect v2 sensors across 80 camera viewpoints. Contains 56,880 video samples across 60 action classes performed by 40 distinct human subjects. Provides synchronized RGB video, depth maps, 3D skeletal joint trajectories (25 joints per body), and infrared sequences.
